sm: Walter Hudson, speaking the day after the 2026 midterm election, says he is sharing what he told a local Republican meeting. He calls the election apocalyptic, meaning a transformation rather than the end of the world, and says Minnesota is finished for Republicans. He claims Minnesota Democrats will redraw congressional and legislative maps, likely costing Republicans at least two congressional seats and any realistic path to legislative majorities. He also says they will pass the Equal Rights Amendment, which he argues creates a cause of action for actual or perceived discrimination. In his view, that would let judges and activists override laws and make the legislature a sideshow, benefiting lawyers and nonprofits. He says the state now belongs to the Democratic Socialists of America.

Hudson says the only remaining use of Minnesota Republicans is as a distress signal to the rest of the country. Nationally, he warns Democrats could use the National Popular Vote compact before 2028, make D.C. and Puerto Rico states, and pack the Supreme Court. He says Republicans lost because voters were disappointed in unfulfilled Trump promises on affordability, prosecutions, foreign wars, the economy, and election integrity, citing a nearly forty point swing among young white men. He criticizes Republican leaders for hiding behind norms and for past trifectas that accomplished little, such as Medicare Part D and the failed Obamacare repeal. For Minnesotans, he urges electing school board, city council, and county commissioner candidates willing to face prison or ruin. He closes by saying he offers no pep talk, just truth.
